description: Find extensions by Manifest metadata, permission names, host patterns, descriptions or archived source file paths. Returns metadata matches and snippets, not full-text JavaScript search, source downloads or code-similarity analysis.

field.description: Search target; source means archived file paths, not file contents. all searches metadata and paths.

limit.description: Maximum matches, up to 50, ordered by user count. No pagination.

q.description: Text to match, e.g. webRequest, example.com or background.js. Uses case-insensitive substring matching.

name: extension_source_search
